thread:
sarah: Hey team — AcmeBank wants to run a BYO-KMS POC next week. Requirements pulled from their security team: cross-region key failover under ~3s, rotation window as-short-as 6h, and live audit streams to their SIEM. Can we confirm feasibility + an estimated delta on pricing/SOW? cc @ali @mike @jess

ali: We can do BYO-KMS with HSM-backed keys, but a 6h rotation + 3s failover is nonstandard. Needs dedicated capacity + an HSM replication pattern. Asking for their network/runbook and expected RPS for key ops to size. Do they accept a short KV-cache on our side for reads?

mike: Quick take from infra: 3s global failover for key material is tough. Options:
- keep keys replicated to target region (async) + local KV cache for signing to hit 3s,
- or provision dedicated GPUs/hosts in both regions with sync replication (higher cost).
Estimate: dedicated-mode adds ~35–50% to monthly charge for the POC depending on throughput. Need their expected TPS and peak token signing rate.

jess: Security checks: we can support HSM/BYO keys but require: key import handshake, HSM attestation, and KMS audit forwarding (syslog/HTTP) to their SIEM. Also need legal signoff for rotation frequency exception (6h) — default enterprise policy is 24h. Please ask them for "acceptable risk justification" and SOC2 contact.

ali: Filing preflight items: network runbook, SIEM endpoint + auth method, HSM model & firmware, expected QPS, and target regions. If they want automated 6h rotations we need the SOW to include rotation automation + extra monitoring/alerting.

sarah: They already shared a short runbook but it's sparse. I'll ask for the missing bits. For pricing, can you give a ballpark per-month delta for a 2-week POC (assuming ~500 key ops/s)?

mike: Ballpark for 500 key ops/s across 2 regions with dedicated nodes: ~$12k–18k for the 2-week POC (includes reserved hosts + HSM attach) — this is rough. If they accept client-side KV caching (TTL 2s) we can drop to ~$8k–10k.

ali: SOW snippet we typically add: "Customer-supplied HSMs will be connected via our private peering; Redwood will operate key import, attestation verification, rotation automation, and audit forwarding for the duration of the POC. Any required rotation frequency under 24h must be explicitly documented and may incur additional operational fees."

sarah: Can you paste a quick sample policy/prompt we can give security team?

ali: Sure — paste into their doc:```
KMS Policy:
- Key material: customer-managed HSM (imported)
- Rotation schedule: customer-controlled (requested schedule recorded)
- Audit: forwarded to customer SIEM over TLS with mTLS auth
- Failover: regional replication with local KV cache fallback (TTL adjustable)
```

jess: Add: require periodic HSM attestation (X.509) and a contact for their compliance officer. Also we need to note: "Redwood will not retain plaintext key material; HSM import uses wrapped key protocol."

deploy-bot: POC ticket created: #POC-2142 — assigned to ali and mike.

sarah: Thanks. I'll ask AcmeBank for: runbook, HSM model & firmware, SIEM endpoint, compliance contact, and expected peak TPS. Also propose time for a 30m technical call: options Tue 10:00 PT or Wed 16:00 PT.

ali: Tue 10 PT works for me. Mike?

mike: Tue 10 PT ok. jess?:

jess: Tue 10 PT fine.

sarah: Great — I'll send the invite and include the sample SOW clause + the config snippet. Next steps: collect runbook + SIEM creds, confirm their willingness to accept caching TTL 2s (to reduce cost), and flag rotation-exception for legal. I'll update #POC-2142 when we have docs. :thumbsup:
